name: Poisoned Skull

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 31 Thievery check to identify the toxin and delicately wipe it free before burning the tainted cloth; on a critical success, the character can pinpoint two areas where the skull can be safely carried and, perhaps, used as an improvised thrown weapon to poison a creature.

items.name: Stain and Pain
items.text:
Trigger A creature comes in contact with the skull

---
Effect The contact poison turns the exposed flesh a deep scarlet color that persists for 24 hours and also afflicts the creature with nettleweed residue.

---
Saving Throw DC 27 Fortitude save

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 6 minutes

Stage 1 3d6 poison damage (1 minute)

Stage 2 4d6 poison damage (1 minute)

Stage 3 6d6 poison damage (1 minute)

text: A fast-acting toxin that's almost invisible to the eye coats the first and seventh skull on this display shelf.
